mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum is the only native issuance deployment. Its MinterV0 and OZ AccessManager path requires beneficiary-signed orders, maximum-mint and rolling-rate checks, and a four-hour token-mint delay; the 4/7 operator Safe can raise the native cap after one day and replace mint logic after three days. Base and BSC are CCIP bridge representations: their pool-gated mint/burn, caps, pool rotation, pause, and UUPS controls are assessed only in Bridge Risk and do not expand native Mint Authority. The Ethereum native mint remains economically unbounded, periodically reconciled, and attestation-supervised.

controls.label: apxUSD AccessManager — Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770531, apxUSD.mint() resolved to AccessManager role 4 and MinterV0 held that role with a 14,400-second delay. MinterV0 requestMint() and executeMint() resolved to role 2, held by Safe 0xf9862efc with zero caller delay; its native order path enforces the configured maximum-mint and rolling-rate checks. setSupplyCap() resolved to role 23 (Safe delay 86,400 seconds) and upgradeToAndCall() to role 24 (Safe delay 259,200 seconds). hasRole(0) was false for both the initial deployer and Safe, while AccessManager administration selectors remained assigned to role 0.

controls.label: Apyx MinterV0 — Ethereum scheduled mint contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770531, authority() returned AccessManager 0xe167330e. MinterV0 held the token's current role 4 with a 14,400-second delay; the Safe held role 2 used by requestMint() and executeMint(). The official source shows order validation, maximum-mint and rolling-rate checks, scheduling, and delayed execution through AccessManager.

controls.label: Apyx ROLE_MINTER Safe — Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770531, getOwners() returned the seven listed addresses, getThreshold() returned 4, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, getModulesPaginated() returned no modules, and slot 0 resolved to the Safe 1.4.1 master copy. AccessManager hasRole(2) returned true with zero caller delay; the Safe can request and execute MinterV0 orders after its 4-of-7 threshold, with the downstream token mint delayed four hours. It can raise the Ethereum token supply cap through role 23 after a one-day delay and holds operational roles 21-25, including the three-day UUPS upgrade role, while role 0 has no current external holder.

controls.label: Apyx Ethereum UUPS/cap authority — 4/7 Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770531, the native proxy had a nonzero EIP-1967 implementation slot, no proxy-admin or beacon slot, and an implementation returning the UUPS proxiable UUID. Ethereum role 24 was held by the Safe with a 259,200-second delay and role 23 controlled the native cap with an 86,400-second delay. Base/BSC representation upgrade, cap, pause, and pool-rotation facts are retained in Bridge Risk controls.

review.evidence: Current fixed-block reads on 2026-08-16 resolved Ethereum's native UUPS implementation 0xdd71fd677fde2ed2579a3c45204f41a11016ccb4, AccessManager 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824, 750,000,000 native cap, and MinterV0 delayed mint path at block 25770531. Base block 50064463 and BSC block 116350114 resolved their separate bridged-token implementations, AccessManagers, configured CCIP pools, and destination caps; those token-level mint/burn and upgrade/cap/pause controls are Bridge Risk representations, not native issuance. The Ethereum Safe remains 4-of-7 with no enabled modules, and the one-day cap delay plus three-day upgrade delay leave native issuance economically unbounded. Apyx's periodic Wolf & Company attestations and the BVI service-entity model support periodic reconciliation under attestation-only supervision.
